declare
 temp_qc_frequency varchar2(1);
 temp_expiry_date date;
 temp_exp_flag varchar2(1) := 'N';
begin
 nullchk;
 begin
 select qc_frequency, qc_expiry_date into temp_qc_frequency, temp_expiry_date
 from test_kits k
 where k.test_kit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_kit_id
 and k.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and k.test_chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and (testing_lab_code = :ctrl_blk_1.user_lab_code 
 or :ctrl_blk_1.user_lab_code = '99');
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('3110');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.kit_lot_number is not null
 then
 begin
 select distinct 'x' into :GLOBAL.x
 from usable_reagents k
 where k.test_kit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_kit_id
 and k.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and (k.reagent_id, k.reagent_code) in
 (select reagent_id, reagent_code
 from reagent_store_mst s
 where s.kit_lot_number = :ctrl_blk_1.kit_lot_number
 and s.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and s.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id);
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('3130');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 if temp_qc_frequency = 'P' and temp_expiry_date is null
 then
 -- following query is duplicated to allow proper locking
 -- of single use kits while minimizing unnecessary locking 
 -- of other kits.
 select qc_expiry_date into temp_expiry_date
 from test_kits k
 where k.test_kit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_kit_id
 and k.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and k.test_chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 for update of qc_expiry_date;
 if temp_expiry_date is null
 then
 update test_kits k set qc_expiry_date = sysdate
 where k.test_kit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_kit_id
 and k.test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and k.test_chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id;
 else
 show_error('3132');
 check_package_failure;
 temp_exp_flag := 'Y';
 :ctrl_blk_1.parm_check_flag := 'N';
 :ctrl_blk_1.void_code := 'REAG'; 
 end if;
 elsif temp_qc_frequency = 'P' then
 show_error('3132');
 check_package_failure;
 temp_exp_flag := 'Y';
 :ctrl_blk_1.parm_check_flag := 'N';
 :ctrl_blk_1.void_code := 'REAG';
 else
 select nvl(max(result_dats),sysdate)
 into :ctrl_blk_1.result_dats
 from holding_tests 
 where tb_id = :ctrl_blk_1.tb_id
 and test_chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id;
 if nvl(temp_expiry_date, sysdate + 1) <= :ctrl_blk_1.result_dats
 then
 show_error('3132');
 check_package_failure;
 temp_exp_flag := 'Y';
 :ctrl_blk_1.parm_check_flag := 'N';
 :ctrl_blk_1.void_code := 'REAG';
 else
 :ctrl_blk_1.parm_check_flag := null;
 :ctrl_blk_1.void_code := null;
 end if;
 end if;
 IF temp_exp_flag = 'N' THEN
 DECLARE
 temp_x varchar2(1); 
 BEGIN
 SELECT distinct 'x' INTO temp_x 
 FROM test_kit_reagents
 WHERE test_kit_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_kit_id
 AND expiry_date < sysdate
 AND test_chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 show_error('3132');
 check_package_failure;
 temp_exp_flag := 'Y';
 :ctrl_blk_1.parm_check_flag := 'N';
 :ctrl_blk_1.void_code := 'REAG';
 EXCEPTION 
 WHEN no_data_found THEN 
 null;
 WHEN others THEN
 handle_error;
 END;
 end if;
exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

 begin
 select count(*)
 into temp_cnt
 from equipment_event
 where equip_reference = temp_rel_code
 and temp_date between downtime_start and
 nvl(downtime_end, sysdate);
 if temp_cnt = 0 then
 select count(*)

 if temp_cnt = 0 then

 and not exists

 and eqc.qc_type = q1.qc_type
 and qc_status = 'A'
 and decode(eqc.qc_period, 'H', sysdate, trunc(sysdate)) <
 decode(eqc.qc_period,
 'H',
 q1.qc_date + (1 / 24 * eqc.frequency),
 'D',
 q1.qc_date + (1 * eqc.frequency),
 'W',
 q1.qc_date + (7 * eqc.frequency),
 add_months(q1.qc_date,

 end if;
 if temp_cnt != 0 then
 :parms.accept_flag := 'N';
 show_error('9004');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :parms.accept_flag := 'Y';
 end if;
 else
 :parms.accept_flag := 'N';
 show_error('9007');
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 elsif :parms.datatype = 'REAGENT' then
 temp_rel_parm := null;
 if :system.cursor_record != '1' then
 up;
 if :parms.datatype = 'DATETIME' then
 --MS temp_rel_parm := :parms.parm_value;
 
 --MS
 if :global.is_time_enabled = 'Y' then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_gmt_time(:global.chapter_id,
 to_date(:parms.parm_value_dum,
 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'),
 v_gmt_time);
 temp_rel_parm := to_char(v_gmt_time, 'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI');
 else
 temp_rel_parm := :parms.parm_value_dum;
 end if;
 --
 
 else
 message('System error, prior code should be DATETIME, contact IS.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 down;
 else
 message('System error, should not be first parameter, contact IS.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 begin
 
 select expiry_date
 into temp_date
 from reagent_store_mst
 where chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.chapter_id
 and test_id = :ctrl_blk_1.test_id
 and reagent_code = :parms.related_code
 and reagent_id = :parms.parm_value;
 
 if temp_date <
 nvl(to_rrdate(temp_rel_parm, 'mm/dd/RR hh24:mi'), sysdate) then
 :parms.accept_flag := 'N';
 show_error('9030');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 :parms.accept_flag := 'Y';
 end if;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('2509');
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 -- not device or reagent, get value for related parameter
 if :parms.related_code is not null then
 temp_rel_code := :parms.related_code;
 temp_rel_parm := null;
 temp_cur_rec := :system.cursor_record;
 go_record('1');
 :system.message_level := '20'; -- Added by Kishore on 09/21/2012
 loop
 if :parms.parm_code = temp_rel_code then
 temp_rel_parm := :parms.parm_value;
 end if;
 down;
 exit when :system.cursor_record = temp_cur_rec;

 :system.message_level := '0'; -- Added by Kishore on 09/21/2012
 check_numerics(temp_rel_parm);
 
 if temp_rel_parm is null then

 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 else

 end if;
 
 -- check if other parameters reference the current one
 temp_rel_parm := :parms.parm_value;
 temp_cur_code := :parms.parm_code;
 temp_cur_rec := :system.cursor_record;
 loop
 :system.message_level := '20'; -- Added by Kishore on 09/21/2012
 down;
 :system.message_level := '0'; -- Added by Kishore on 09/21/2012
 if :parms.related_code = temp_cur_code and
 :parms.parm_value is not null then
 begin

 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';

 go_record(temp_cur_rec);
 if :system.last_record = 'FALSE' and :parms.datatype = 'DATETIME' then
 down;
